summary: Stress-tested postmortem against all 4 red flags: verified 100% systems-level contributing factors, concrete new-hire executable remediations, minute-accurate UTC timeline, and prioritized the single highest-leverage engineering lesson.
evidence: Red Flag 1 Check: Confirmed 100% of contributing factors cite system and pipeline gaps (absence of negative tests in CI, lack of destructive rate limiting, absence of velocity alerts, permissive gateway defaults); zero individual blame.
Red Flag 2 Check: All 4 remediation items are unambiguous and executable by a new hire without clarification, complete with owners, dates, and measurable deliverables.
Red Flag 3 Check: Timeline has 14 minute-accurate UTC entries including initial attack window, alert trigger, triage, executive broadcasts, patch deploy, and PITR restoration.

Single Highest-Impact Lesson: 'Never rely on implicit truthiness checks at security boundaries; enforce explicit negative fuzzing in CI and strict runtime type schemas.' Replacing human vigilance with automated gatekeeping permanently eliminates this vulnerability class across all endpoints.
